headline: High: open-webui’s browser/MCP/file access can amplify Authelia-authenticated workflows into prompt injection, leakage, and unsafe action cascades.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Authelia can front access via OIDC/ForwardAuth, while open-webui ingests files, MCP, and web content through tool use. That creates a plausible instruction-injection bridge if Authelia-protected content is passed into open-webui, though no direct shared channel is documented. Uncertainty keeps this at medium, not low.
conditions: IF Authelia-protected pages or files are copied into open-webui chats or tools
IF open-webui parses retrieved web/file content as instructions without provenance checks
mitigations: Disable automatic ingestion of untrusted pages into chats
Require provenance labels on retrieved content
Use a separate read-only workspace for imported files
Turn off MCP tools not needed for the workflow
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and instruction-separation filters

B_data_leakage.rationale: Authelia handles authentication flows, and open-webui explicitly touches files, mounted volumes, API keys, and persistent memory while also using broad network egress. If the pair shares a workspace or session context, sensitive material can flow from authenticated content into open-webui’s third-party calls. The blast radius includes secrets and documents, so high is warranted.
conditions: IF Authelia-protected documents or tokens are placed in a shared filesystem or pasted into open-webui
IF open-webui forwards that context to external APIs or search tools
mitigations: Keep Authelia and open-webui on separate volumes
Remove secrets from open-webui memory and chats
Restrict open-webui outbound tools to approved endpoints
Rotate any API keys exposed in shared sessions
requires-engineering: enforce per-app data-loss-prevention controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Authelia has broad network egress and OIDC/ForwardAuth surfaces, while open-webui has broad network egress, browser/tool execution, and persistent shared sessions. They do not both show unrestricted filesystem writes, so the high conflict indicator is not met. Still, overlapping networked authority can collide on shared resources or OAuth-backed services.
conditions: IF both agents are configured against the same OAuth or API-backed resource
IF open-webui sessions and Authelia auth flows mutate shared state without locking
mitigations: Assign separate service accounts
Scope each agent to distinct resources
Disable write access where not needed
Stagger state-changing jobs manually
requires-engineering: add resource locking for shared mutable backends

D_cascading_error.rationale: Authelia can gate access decisions, and open-webui can act on tool outputs, browse, and persist session state. If open-webui treats Authelia-mediated content or identity assertions as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream actions or incorrect access decisions. Because the pair can combine authentication and action-taking, the blast radius is substantial.
conditions: IF open-webui uses Authelia-derived claims or content without verification
IF open-webui triggers tools or subprocesses based on those claims
mitigations: Add a human verification step before actions
Require signed or structured claims from Authelia
Log and review tool-triggering prompts
Disable automatic execution for identity-derived inputs
requires-engineering: implement assertion verification and policy checks

E_compliance.rationale: Authelia is an authentication layer, while open-webui stores prompts, documents, notes, files, and API keys and can use external APIs. The pair can therefore place regulated or sensitive data into a broader retention and logging surface, but the profiles do not prove a specific residency or certification mismatch. That makes medium the safest supported severity.
conditions: IF regulated data is authenticated through Authelia and then stored in open-webui memory or logs
IF open-webui sends that data to external services without a DPA or retention controls
mitigations: Avoid storing regulated data in open-webui
Purge chat history after sensitive sessions
Disable analytics and unnecessary logging
Use region-appropriate external services only
requires-engineering: document residency, retention, and DPA controls
